scope: Qualify only the local CalculiX conversion of prescribed nodal temperature into axial thermal strain and restraint force in a generic T3D2 truss bar. Test uniform free expansion, uniform fully restrained expansion and a free axial linear temperature gradient against closed-form solutions and mesh invariance. This is a purely mechanical static analysis with a prescribed temperature field, not a heat-transfer, fire or coupled thermal solution. No WTC 1 geometry, temperature, fireproofing, connection, load path or historical outcome is assigned.
